standard.correct: All requested material rulings resolved, source/key matched, no contradictory or unresolved requested part.
standard.partial: One or more requested parts omitted or explicitly unresolved, without a materially false affirmative ruling.
standard.incorrect: A materially false ruling or contradiction, even if other parts correct.
standard.unrequested_key_context: Not automatically required merely because included in fixed key.
standard.evidence_fields: Use factual content anywhere within the complete same-question response: answer, evidence and requested_parts when they actually assert a rule. A question-label/checklist label or section citation alone supplies no missing fact. Do not borrow across answers. A quoted correct rule cannot retract an explicit contradictory ruling.

general_scope_standard: Material actual requested clauses, complete same-question factual response/evidence, no required exact phrasing or automatically demanded unasked key context.
